subject: Focus decision: Alpha3 source-switch temporal safety / fallback discontinuity fencing
body: Discovery/gap gate complete against current Alpha3 runtime 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70. Selected C1 source-switch temporal safety score=27. Confirmed source path: Fold7AngleAuthority.promotePublic can emit a retained public candidate whose observedUptimeMs predates the last precise output; HingeAngleSource forwards it unchanged; Fold7HingeIngressBatch preserves decision order but not monotonic observation time; Fold7ContinuityController derives motion direction from angle delta without source identity. Strong hypothesis: precise expiry/revoke can turn a source-switch discontinuity into a false close/open/reversal, including immediate strong-close/prewarm. Independent boundary: deterministic source-only authority-to-continuity contract validation. Sensor proof, build-integrity, daemon-restart, renderer and device-readiness work are excluded. Cheapest first test: public shadow t=1050/90deg, precise t=1180/175deg, expire at t=1373, then prove or reject downstream false closing motion.
